presets.name: hold
presets.description: Static panel. Use for quiet exposition or dialogue-heavy beats.

presets.name: zoom
presets.description: Smooth push in (to > from) or pull out (to < from), optionally centred on a focus point such as a face.

presets.name: pan
presets.description: Slow camera drift across the panel. Use for establishing shots and wide panels.

presets.name: shake
presets.description: Continuous camera shake. Use for rumbling, explosions or sustained tension.

presets.name: action_tilt
presets.description: Fast punch-in with a dutch tilt that settles. Use for hits, reveals and sudden action.

presets.name: kinetic_jitter
presets.description: Violent jitter that decays over the beat. Use for impacts, shock and screams.

presets.name: panoramic_fade
presets.description: Wide pan that fades in and out. Use for scene changes, flashbacks and time skips.

presets.name: split_screen
presets.description: Two or three panels share the frame and slide in one after another. Use for confrontations and parallel reactions.

presets.name: floating_panels
presets.description: Two or three tall panels float over the background like physical photos layered in 3D, with heavy shadows and a slow drift. Use for character introductions, line-ups and reflective moments.

presets.name: horizontal_slices
presets.description: Two or three ultra-wide, short panels stacked as strips that drift slowly in opposite directions. Use for intimate close-ups, eye contact and tense stare-downs.

presets.name: hud_popup
presets.description: Game-style info panel types onto the screen over the panel. Use for system messages, stats and level-ups.
